evidence_status: conditional exploratory nested admission over already-frozen OOF proposal surfaces; not end-to-end nested stacking and not yet deployable
hypothesis: a target-blind selector can choose a safe subset of the complementary pairwise, RRF-3, and focused LambdaMART proposals while preserving the complete current policy as the default
unique_variable: deduplicate the three frozen proposal families into a per-turn action portfolio and learn one fixed two-head causal admission rule with a one-supplement-per-session latch

action_contract.construction_scope: all 2000 cached sessions and all visible turns, without filtering on target, current hit, eligible_from, oracle membership, or outcome
action_contract.current_served_choice: current ranker choice when its frozen admission activates, otherwise the P11 slot-10 incumbent
action_contract.available_when: a family proposal differs from both the current served choice and the P11 incumbent
action_contract.keep: bit-exact current chosen and activation arrays

causal_runtime_policy.scan: process turns in ascending order from the first visible turn; eligible_from is never consulted
causal_runtime_policy.within_turn: score only actions visible at the current turn and choose maximum utility, then higher family support, then lower candidate ordinal
causal_runtime_policy.activation: execute the first within-turn winner whose utility is at least the frozen threshold, set the session latch, and KEEP on every later turn
forbidden: session-global maximum over all ten turns
candidate or session identifiers as model features
more than one supplemental action per session

runtime_feature_contract.rank_definition: stable allowed-C100 rank fraction computed independently on each frozen surface

training_labels.construction: replace one action row in isolation on top of the complete frozen current-policy trace; labels may use evaluator outcomes but are never runtime features
training_labels.rescue: current session miss becomes a hit
training_labels.regret: isolated action lowers reciprocal rank or increases first-hit turn relative to current
training_labels.reciprocal_rank_loss: max(0, current reciprocal rank minus isolated-action reciprocal rank)
training_labels.mttc_loss: max(0, isolated-action first-hit turn minus current first-hit turn)
training_labels.weight_normalization: normalize each head's action weights to sum to one within each session

model.type: two weighted standardized L2 logistic regressions
model.preprocessing: weighted mean and scale fitted only on the corresponding training partition; constant scale becomes one

cross_fit.outer: hold out one fixed product-family fold from selector model fitting and threshold admission
cross_fit.inner: within outer-train, cross-fit both heads over the fixed inner folds and simulate the exact causal latch policy
cross_fit.threshold_candidates: fixed quantiles 0/64 through 63/64 of inner-OOF per-turn winner utilities plus KEEP
cross_fit.inner_safety: aggregate and every inner fold must have zero hit-to-miss, nonnegative net hits, nonnegative MRR delta, and nonpositive MTTC delta
cross_fit.inner_evidence_minimum: aggregate has at least one miss-to-hit and at least two inner folds have a miss-to-hit
cross_fit.safe_candidate_order: technical-score delta, net rescue, positive-fold count, fewer supplemental actions, higher quantile
cross_fit.outer_mapping: refit both heads on all outer-train rows and map the selected quantile to the unlabeled outer-train per-turn winner utility distribution; never copy a raw threshold across fits
cross_fit.held_outer_policy: apply the mapped threshold with the same chronological first-passing latch policy
cross_fit.claim_boundary: the selector is nested conditional on frozen base OOF surfaces; a positive result requires strict outer/inner regeneration of all upstream proposal surfaces before a no-family-leakage claim

posthoc_reporting_and_stop_rule.observed_but_excluded_from_v2_7: a fixed late-turn multi-action round-robin was discovered posthoc and must not be represented as a v2.7 preregistered result
posthoc_reporting_and_stop_rule.if_no_direction_pass: close the learned one-action selector without model, feature, weight, multiplier, or threshold tuning; separately register a materially new proposal or an explicitly posthoc multi-action validation route
posthoc_reporting_and_stop_rule.if_direction_pass: rebuild pairwise, RRF-3, and focused proposal surfaces inside every meta outer/inner training domain before deployment claims
